cohort: professional-tier sweep: the 274 authors whose best free-harvest link is NOT a LinkedIn and NOT a permanent academic page (158 ORCID-only, 98 GitHub-only, 12 email, 6 personal sites)
his_ruling: 2026-08-26: do ALL of them, in as few sittings as possible. An ACTIVE FACULTY PAGE ends the question - no LinkedIn lookup needed for that person. GitHub-only people are hard; try anyway, using the GitHub account itself as evidence (real name, company, location, personal site, and repos tied to the person's paper).
method_addition: Before or alongside the LinkedIn search, read the GitHub profile via api.github.com (name/company/location/blog). It supplies the identity anchor for the LinkedIn match AND exposes bad harvest matches - see wrong_github_matches below.
